A note from us
We are so glad you’re here.

If you’re reading this, it’s because you’re one of the people we love most — and we cannot wait to celebrate with you in September. We’ve been working on this site to make the weekend as easy as possible: when to show up, where to sleep, what to wear, and (importantly) how to get from the train station to a barn in the middle of the Catskills.

A few things to know up front: the wedding will be outside, weather permitting. There will be a long table of food. There will be dancing. There will be a slightly chaotic shuttle situation that we promise we have under control. And there will be us — extremely happy, slightly sweaty, asking you how your drive was.

Thank you for making the trip. Thank you for showing up for us, again and again, for all the years that got us here.

— Maya & Devon

How we got here

A very short version

We met in 2019 at a community garden in Crown Heights — Devon was on the bed of overgrown tomatoes, Maya was supposed to be weeding. Six years, one pandemic, three apartments, and one extremely cold proposal on a black-sand beach in Iceland later, here we are.
